API key management

Webhook: API key created

POST
https://common-api.karma.life
/webhook/api_key.created

Fired when a new API key is created. The plaintext key is stripped from the payload for security. Note: as of writing, the publisher path has a TODO and may not yet be wired to Pub/Sub.

This is an outbound webhook event. Karma POSTs this payload to the URL you registered via POST /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions. Your endpoint should respond 2xx within 30 seconds to acknowledge delivery.

Webhook: API key created › Request Body

Standard envelope wrapping every outbound webhook event.
id
​string · required

Unique webhook delivery ID

event
​string · enum · required
Enum values:
api_key.created
resource
​string · enum · required
Enum values:
api_key
resourceId
​string · required

String ID of the affected resource

timestamp
​string · date-time · required

ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was emitted

apiVersion
​string · enum · required
Enum values:
v1
​object

Webhook: API key created › Responses

200

Acknowledged. Karma considers any 2xx response a successful delivery; non-2xx triggers retry with exponential backoff.

No data returned
POST/webhook/api_key.created
curl --request POST \ --url https://common-api.karma.life/webhook/api_key.created \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data ' { "id": "evt_01HZK3...", "event": "api_key.created", "resource": "api_key", "resourceId": "resourceId", "timestamp": "2024-08-25T15:00:00Z", "apiVersion": "v1", "data": { "keyId": "keyId", "apiKey": {} } } '
Example Request Body
{ "id": "evt_01HZK3...", "event": "api_key.created", "resource": "api_key", "resourceId": "resourceId", "timestamp": "2024-08-25T15:00:00Z", "apiVersion": "v1", "data": { "keyId": "keyId", "apiKey": {} } }
json
